usage: A common noun for moss, especially the soft green growth you see on walls, rocks, tree trunks, or damp ground.
Often used when talking about wet, shady, or old places; it has a slightly natural-scene feel.
Can appear by itself as a mass noun, so you usually do not need a classifier.
In everyday Cantonese, it is a simple vocabulary word for plants and nature descriptions; useful in reading and basic conversation.
